Justice for Maryka - ex-capt Awie Geldenhuys

By: Michael Duffett | Production

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
alleged police captin finally thrown out of the force

Unique Selling Point:
We look at then history of of police captain Alwie Geldenhuys who has worked in the Middleburg are for over 20 years. Numerous allegations of against him - taking advantage of vulnerable women and using a date rape drug to rape them. Once he was thrown out of the police but re-instated when the complainant did not come to court. Then late last year his girl friend died mysteriously and police docket was opened. A face book page called Justice for Marayka went up, detailing his . history of
alleged abuse. A Middleburg reporter has been on his case for over ten years. And then earlier this year, attempted rape charges were laid against him. Just recently was fired from the police. How and why has this taken so long?

Summary:
Reporter Daleen from the MiddleBurg Observer first wrote about this man in 2008 when women went to lay charges for rape. One was his girl friend..who was horrified that her younger sister was a victim. The girl friend will speak to us. Police only proceeded with one case and that fell away when she did not testify. Have case number. 3 years later three more woman reported rape. Geldenhuys was thrown out of police force but re-instated when there was no court case. In 2016 a woman taken out of a bar (we have footage) and found later battered. After that story went out into the media, many women came forward with similar stories including one under aged girl at the time. She had a fight with her boyfriend and the police man said that he would take her home. He said first that he would give her a pill to take away her headache. She went woozy, she felt she had been drugged and she later found him molesting her. Mathery other allegations came through as well from others.





Further information:
Then Maraka died - he says she threw herself out of a car. Family feel she was murdered. Policeman did not report her death to her parents.
Family will talk. Then a few months later he is accused again of attempted rape. Case number.


Police confirm that he had been thrown out of the police force finally -and IPID has launched a full investigation , confirming investigating three charges against him which could increase as they speak to more and more alleged victims.

Press Release:


Mpumalanga Murder Mystery
To protect and serve – that’s the pledge that police officers make to the public – so why did a police captain from Emalahleni become the target of several allegations of rape and sexual assault? As a devastated family tries to understand why their 32-year-old daughter jumped to her death from a moving vehicle while in the company of the then captain early this year, Carte Blanche investigates the case and allegations against the now-suspended officer that have shocked Mpumalanga.
Producer: Michael Duffet | Presenter: Masa Kekana


Script:


PROMOS

From 2008 a prominent police captain in Mpumalanga has faced numerous allegations of rape…and earlier this year his girlfriend died under mysterious circumstances. We speak to his alleged victims.

A prominent police captain has just been fired from the police after being charged for attempted murder.,. Earlier this year his girlfriend died in mysterious circumstances. We investigate.

Maryka Bezuidenhout died under mysterious circumstances Her boyfriend a prominent police captain said she SHE THREW HESWLF OUT OF HIS MOVING CAR, WAS IT SUIVICE?



SCRIPT

Winnie
She was very bubbly, she always got everybody to like her immediately,

VO
Winnie Bezuidenhout always had a strong connection with her younger sister Maryka. So nothing could have prepared her and the rest of the family for the tragedy that unfolded earlier this year.

Link
On Sunday the 27th of Jan, Maryka Bezuidenhout Kleinman’s was returning from a resort just outside Middleburg with her boyfriend Awie Geldenhuys. They were travelling on the N11 at night. He allegedly he told Maryka’s parents that the she jumped from the car after an argument.

VO
Maryka’s family and friends refused to believe that Maryka – who had a young daughter –would take her own life. Within weeks of her death a Facebook page was launched – “Justice for Maryka”.

LINK
So, who is Awie Geldenhuys? Until recently he was a captain of the SA Police services and he was stationed in several police stations in Mpumalanga and by most accounts a popular man.

But in 2007 Geldenhuys came under the radar of Daleen Naude, the Middleburg Observer’s senior journalist, when she reported that a 22-year-old woman had laid a charge of rape against Geldenhuys at the Middleburg Police station. The case did not proceed, as the complainant went abroad.

The next time Naude reported on Geldenhuys was in 2011 when he was arrested in Nelspruit for rape under the sexual offences act.

Naude: he was charged departmentally and was re-instated when the women did not go to court. According to Naude the two complainants had left town and did not return for the trial.

VO
A few years later Geldenhuys made the newspaper once again.

MASA
In 2016 a 19-year-old woman was inside this venue in Middelburg formerly known as Amazons.

Geldenhuys was also inside. Naude obtained this CCTV footage which shows him approaching the young woman.

DALEEN
He carried her out of the place and according to her they drive a long time…and they went to a house where a blond woman gave her a pill. And then remembered nothing.

VO
The next morning, she was found semi-conscious on a sidewalk.

Daleen
Her parents were very upset she never laid charges and I don’t know why she did not lay charges.

VO
Naude confronted Geldenhuys – and he said her he had dropped her off near her home. After publishing this story, Naude was inundated with phone calls from women all over the country.

Daleen
They also said that they were victims – they all became very emotional, most of them started to cry when they spoke to me.

VO
We met one of the women who had called the journalist. Now 30 years old, she told us that back in 2007, when she was 17, she met Geldenhuys at a night spot in Middleburg. We call her Adelle, as she didn’t want her identity revealed. (FACT CHECK NUMBERS PLEASE).

ADELLE
In the group, he was the nicest person you would meet. He was asking if he can get you a drink, he was very nice.

Adelle said Geldenhuys offered to take her home and suggested that they drop by his house so he can give her a pill to prevent a hangover. She said she trusted him because he was a policeman.

ADELLE
And it was a couple of minutes afterwards that I started to feel unwell. I felt woozy, I felt like I was going numb.

Adelle said she had to lie down and then felt she was slipping in and out of consciousness . – she woke to find Geldenhuys straddling her. She was unable to move. (FACT CHECK)

Adelle
He was fiddling down there, had his fingers in there, I could remember it was hurting.

Like many other alleged victims, Adelle didn’t lay charges.

Naude
Most of them said that no one would believe them because they were minors at the time, they were in places where under 18s are not allowed.

VO:
This 32-year-old woman whom we call Erica also did not lay charges.

Erica: What stopped me from talking ...I was a 16-year-old girl. Standing up against a police officer. He is the law

In 2003, after a night out in Secunda, sonia and her friend accepted a lift home from Geldenhuys…who was known to the girls as Uncle Awie. When Geldenhuys dropped off the friend, and then then drove straight past Erica’s home.

Petra
There is something that keeps on telling you. You with police officers, you will be fine.

VO
Petra says Geldenhuys took her to EENDE DAM in Secunda – where he shoved something into her mouth and then raped her.

Petro
I could not do anything; his body weight was just so overpowering. From behind mostly everything happened.

VO
It’s these types of allegations levelled at Geldenhuys that Johan Bezuidenhout discovered on the internet, which made him fear for his daughter’s.safety. At that stage Maryka had been dating Geldenhuys for about 6 months. He tried to warn her…it was just two days before she ended up dead.

Johan
It was the Friday and she scanned through the info, and she said PA, this is not him…he has not been found guilty…

VO
Maryka died on the Sunday at about 8 pm on the N11 highway. What upset the family most was that Geldenhuys did not contact them straight away. It appears he phoned Winnie’s friend’s husband. She then sent a Facebook message to Winnie only the next day. She and her mom then rushed over to Geldenhuys’ home.

Winnie
I hooted, there is no doorbell.

VO
Winnie said Geldenhuys’ brother came out, screaming at them.

Mother
I just want to see Awie, and I want to find out what happened to Daughter. And he said, yes your daughter committed suicide.

VO
The devastated family spent the whole day searching mortuaries and hospitals before they finally found Maryka’s body.

Winnie
To see her broken and lifeless body, I can’t exactly remember what went through my mind…. but... you keep telling yourself, if you look closer its not going to be her.

MOTHER
It’s heartbreaking

Father
For me it was, what was her last thought? Before she passed on…wad she hurt, was she in pain…. was she just……?

VO
Distraught family and friends came together a few days later to pay tribute to Maryka.

Masa
Do you think your sister committed suicide?

Winnie
No, not for second do I believe that.

VO
Two months after Maryka’s death, another woman laid charges against Geldenhuys for attempted rape. Despite not being found guilty of any crime yet, South African Police Service spokesperson Brigadier Leonard Hlati confirmed that Geldenhuys was recently dismissed from the police service.

POLICE
Firstly, he was dismissed on an assault GBH case, followed by sexual assault, as well as bringing the SAPS into disrepute. The dismissal was confirmed by the provincial commissioner. He can’t be a SAPS member behaving in that way, bring the name of the police into the mud.

VO
We offered Geldenhuys the right to reply to all the allegations.

Masa
How are you, I am Masa from Carte Blanche…? we here to talk to you about the death of Maryka and several other women we spoke to. Who have alleged rape. And sexual abuse from you…?

Geldenhuys
I will get back to you

Masa
So you have nothing to say …. because we have spoken to several women, Mr Geldenhuys, who say that you have raped them, date drugged them…. Given them drugs.

VO
Several attempts to get a response from him were unsuccessful.

VO  
In the meantime the Independent Police Investigative Directorate – or IPID – is still investigating Maryka’ death and the attempted rape charge. They also said they had finished their investigations into this year attempted rape and had forwarded their findings to the NPA. A decision is pending.

Masa: after we air this program there may be many who will come forward with allegations. Can the public be assured that IPID will throw its full force into this?

IPID If the cases that might be coming away whether its against the very same CAPTAIN geldenhuyus, or any other person for that matter, it will be inve3stigated by ipid if those cases fall within the mandate of IPID.

VO
Ipid has made an appointment to meet with Petra. She has suffered severe depression most of her life. She now feels strong enough to lay charges against Geldenhuys.

Petra
That is what I want to do…. that is what I need to do, fo0r myself….and to make sure that there wont be ever another lady that needs to go through that.
